title: Awarapan 2
synopsis: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

title: Batwara 1947
synopsis: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

title: Bhai Tera Star Hai
synopsis: An actor's cricket gambling debt puts him on a deadly deadline. His lie about his sister sets off a catastrophic evening of confused criminals, botched crimes, and pandemonium racing across London.

title: Ohh My Dog
synopsis: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
synopsis: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

title: Harrd Disk
synopsis: Entrusted with a hard disk believed to hold information that could topple ministers, a young boy gets caught in a deadly game between a cop and a political fixer. Everybody wants it. No one knows what's inside.

title: Sarvagunn Sampann
synopsis: Play by the book in the day and re-define it by night, what makes a perfect woman?

title: Petals in the Wind
synopsis: A newlywed arranged marriage couple arrive at Goa for their honeymoon. They roam around the city as tourists, slowly getting to know each other in the process. Their honeymoon fantasy comes crashing as an unprecedented revelation sets off a domino of emotional outbursts.

title: Beyond Ratings
synopsis: Three women share their experience of navigating the app-world in the metro city. The sharings reveal gendered battles as platform workers and the tiresome reality of gig-workers' identities against the absent bosses, masked behind their apps. Filmed in the streets of New Delhi, the protagonists share about their door-to-door gigs, the surveillance at their workplaces and the absence of accountability in the urban landscape.

title: The Bose Files: Sach Ya Sazish
synopsis: Veerali joins Anuj, a researcher obsessed with uncovering the truth behind Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's mysterious disappearance, exposing evidence that challenges the official story of his death.

title: Babita Singh Reporting
synopsis: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

title: Haiwaan
synopsis: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

title: Aman
synopsis: A trans man who discovers he is pregnant on the eve of his gender-affirming surgery.

title: The Vvaan
synopsis: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest & awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that some powers exist beyond logic & he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.

title: Gandhari
synopsis: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
synopsis: The battle for Mirzapur's throne escalates as old enemies resurface and new threats emerge. Blood debts must be paid while power-hungry contenders fight to control the city's violent underworld.

title: Daayra
synopsis: No synopsis available.

title: Herland
synopsis: In a deeply conservative Indian village where women are forbidden from stepping outside without male permission, Bhagyashree and her growing sisterhood rise in defiance, claiming their right to work and confronting generations of patriarchal control. As their resistance gathers force, the cost of being seen as equal begins to turn dangerous. How much are they willing to risk?

title: Love Lottery
synopsis: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

title: Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha – Shri Ram Ki
synopsis: No synopsis available.
